Name: Four Corners Expanded
Author: DoctorHadley
Description:
[center]﻿﻿﻿﻿[size=5][size=4]Four Corners Expanded is a farm for you and up to seven friends who found the original Four Corners Farm to be too small.
This map is four times bigger than the original Four Corner[/size][/size][size=4]s farm[/size][size=5].

[/size][size=4]Currently updated to work with 1.6[/size][size=5]

[/size]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ko1ea81.png[/img]﻿[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ to replace the map.

All files are needed, otherwise this map will not work.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/kRxuUCD.png[/img]﻿

Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿

Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

Download the mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods

Run the game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿

Pick Four Corners as your map and enjoy!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/G6QKnfF.png[/img]﻿


1.6 Adds the ability to change the farmhouse location, which moves the mailbox with it.
Because of this I have removed the ability to decide which side the mailbox is on, and it's now back to the default right side.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/hhNUU0i.png[/img]﻿

After running the mod for the first time you'll have the option to change whether or not the farm has ponds.
By default ponds are enabled.

To disable them open the generated config.json and change
  "Ponds" to "False"[/center]

Downloads.Description:
Updated for 1.6
Added config file to change whether or not the farm has ponds
Fixed bus stop warp location
Fixed inability to move farmhouse back to it's original location
Fixed pet bowl spawn location
Added spawn locations for 7 farmhand cabins
